The two difference-density cubes in `files/` were written by `frog-tddft --dct` for the S1 and T1 states
of the same TD-DFT job. They share the same 60 × 60 × 60 grid and the same geometry.

**Files used** (from the repository):

* `files/1_p8_orca_S1_delta_rho.cube` — Δρ(S1) = ρ(S1) − ρ(S0), 48 atoms, 60 × 60 × 60
* `files/1_p8_orca_T1_delta_rho.cube` — Δρ(T1), same grid
* `files/test.cube` — ORCA total electron density of another molecule (19 atoms)

**1. S1 − T1.** The second file minus the first.

```bash
frog-cube -s files/1_p8_orca_T1_delta_rho.cube files/1_p8_orca_S1_delta_rho.cube
```

```text
ℹ  Subtracting: files/1_p8_orca_S1_delta_rho.cube - files/1_p8_orca_T1_delta_rho.cube
✔  Saved cube: 1_p8_orca_S1_delta_rho_minus_1_p8_orca_T1_delta_rho.cube
```

`1_p8_orca_S1_delta_rho_minus_1_p8_orca_T1_delta_rho.cube` (first 8 lines):

```text
Difference
Difference of grids
   48  -13.567617  -14.644758  -10.726177
   60    0.491762    0.000000    0.000000
   60    0.000000    0.524375    0.000000
   60    0.000000    0.000000    0.387622
    7    0.000000    1.600413   -0.293917   -0.783335
    6    0.000000    2.740201   -2.629403   -1.228235
…
```

The new cube has the same header as the first file, with its own title lines: 48 atoms, origin and
60 × 60 × 60 grid. Only the values differ. In a viewer, positive regions (S1 − T1 > 0) are where the
singlet puts more electron density than the triplet. Draw both signs at a small isovalue
(±0.001–0.002 e/bohr³), because the two Δρ largely cancel.

**2. Flip the sign of a cube** with `-m … -1`, written to a chosen path.

```bash
mkdir -p cub && frog-cube -m files/1_p8_orca_S1_delta_rho.cube -1 -o cub/S1_inverted.cube
```

```text
ℹ  Multiplying: files/1_p8_orca_S1_delta_rho.cube * -1
✔  Saved cube: cub/S1_inverted.cube
```

`cub/S1_inverted.cube` (first 4 lines):

```text
Multiplication
Scaled by -1.0
   48  -13.567617  -14.644758  -10.726177
   60    0.491762    0.000000    0.000000
…
```

**3. Cubes on different grids cannot be combined.**

```bash
frog-cube -a files/test.cube files/1_p8_orca_S1_delta_rho.cube
```

```text
ℹ  Adding: files/1_p8_orca_S1_delta_rho.cube + files/test.cube
✖  ERROR: ValueError: Grid origin must match for addition.
```

The command stops with exit code 1 and writes nothing. `files/test.cube` is the density of another
molecule on another box, so its origin differs from that of the Δρ cube.
